## Validation

<!-- List link, metadata, asset, identifier, and continuity checks. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Every fact is already public or explicitly approved by a canon editor.
- [ ] No hidden lore, unpublished twist, editorial planning, private context,
      credentials, personal data, or confidential metadata is included.
- [ ] Corrections, deprecations, and retcons include a canon change record.
- [ ] Shared identifiers and schemas reference released Codex contracts.
- [ ] Public assets have documented rights and contain no editable masters.
- [ ] Related records, publication metadata, and the changelog are consistent.
